lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
prompt: Under Texas Transportation Code §552.003, when must a driver yield right-of-way to a pedestrian in a crosswalk?

options.text: When the pedestrian is on the half of the roadway on which the vehicle is traveling
Only when the pedestrian holds an illuminated handheld warning torch
Only if the pedestrian is crossing within an active public school zone corridor
Pedestrians must always yield to motorized vehicular traffic in crosswalks
